purpose: Allowlisted, rebuildable or discarded data reclaimed by `aphrody-infra reclaim`. Plan by default; deletion only with --apply.
policy: paths are relative to the remote $HOME; absolute paths and '..' are rejected
never list data read by a running unit (nie-model-serve reads .local/share/Steam/iecode and nie/var/model-cache; nie-site runs from nie/target/release)
/tmp is tmpfs: reclaiming it frees RAM and swap, not disk

system steps run through sudo -n: docker prunes only unreferenced images older than 7 days and the build cache (never containers or volumes); absolute system paths must sit below a non-protected root and never under /home, /root, /etc, /boot, /var/lib/docker, /var/lib/postgresql or /var/lib/mysql
